source:
@@U00931@@
(To the MONKEYS.)

@@U00932@@
Tell me, you accursed creatures,
what are you stirring in that stew?

@@U00934@@
Watery soup for beggars.

@@U00936@@
It’s sure to go over well.
(The MALE MONKEY comes over and fawns on

@@U00938@@
)

@@U00940@@
Throw the dice, sir,
And so be nice, sir;
Things are vile,
So win me a pile.
To be rich in pence
Is to have sense.

@@U00942@@
How lucky this monkey would think himself
if only he could play the lottery.
(Meanwhile the YOUNG MONKEYS have been playing with a large
ball, which now they roll forward.)

@@U00944@@
This is the world,
Forever twirled
Round and about.
It rings like glass,
And is, alas,
Hollow, no doubt,
And so it will shatter,
And will little matter
In the round and about.
translation:
@@U00931@@
（对猴子们来说。）

@@U00932@@
告诉我，你们这些被诅咒的生物，
你在炖菜里搅拌什么？

@@U00934@@
给乞丐喝的稀汤。

@@U00936@@
一定会顺利进行的。
（公猴走过来阿谀奉承

@@U00938@@
）

@@U00940@@
先生，掷骰子，
所以，请表现得友善一点，先生；
事情是卑劣的，
所以赢我一堆。
成为富有的便士
就是要有理智。

@@U00942@@
这只猴子会认为自己多么幸运
要是他能玩彩票就好了。
（与此同时，年轻的猴子们一直在和一个大猴子玩耍
球，现在他们向前滚动。）

@@U00944@@
这就是世界，
永远旋转
绕来绕去。
它像玻璃一样响亮，
唉，
空心，毫无疑问，
所以它会破碎，
没什么大不了的
在圆形和左右。
